instruction.text: Which sentence best describes this image?

b: ++The text is displayed in two columns.
The text is displayed in bullet points.

end.text: Good job! The text is displayed in two columns. Columns are often used in newspapers and articles as a clearer way of displaying long sections of text.

b: ++The text is displayed in bullet points.

end.text: Well done. On this leaflet, the text is displayed in bullet points. Bullet points are a good way of clearly displaying key pieces of information.

b: ++The information is displayed in a table.
The information is displayed using diagrams.

end.text: Great work. The bus times are displayed in a table. Tables are a good way to display important information in a way that makes it easy to compare.

instruction.text: Match each layout device to the correct definition.

atoms.b: These can be found at the top of the page and tell you what the text is about.
atoms.sound: Headings can be found at the top of the page and tell you what the text is about.

atoms.b: These are titles given to smaller sections of text and provide additional information.
atoms.sound: Sub-headings are titles given to smaller sections of text and provide additional information.

atoms.b: These are used in lists, and to highlight key information.
atoms.sound: Bullet points are used in lists, and to highlight key information.

atoms.b: These have columns and rows, and are used to highlight important information in a way that allows for comparison.
atoms.sound: Tables have columns and rows, and are used to highlight important information in a way that allows for comparison.

atoms.b: These are used to break up longer sections of text, and are often used in articles.
atoms.sound: Columns are used to break up longer sections of text, and are often used in articles.
